pattern: Agent asked to file in a bound team that is not the project's default
experience: A project bound to several Linear teams filed every agent-created issue in its default team, even when the user named another bound team.

setup.context: The current thread ID is issue-thread. Its project ID is app, for the GitHub repository acme/app. The project is also bound to the Linear teams ENG (its default) and OPS.

prompt: File an issue in our OPS Linear team: the nightly backup job ran twice on Nov 20. No need to investigate, just file it.
